title: Inbound MCP server
description: Expose THIS gateway's tools over MCP so Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT or any MCP-aware agent can call them as you (your BYOK keys). JSON-RPC dispatch derived from TOOL_REGISTRY, per-user bearer tokens stored as sha256 (raw shown once), plus a full OAuth 2.1 authorization server — RFC 7591 dynamic client registration, PKCE S256, single-use 60s auth codes — and the two .well-known discovery documents. The mirror of mcp-client: this one SERVES tools, that one CONSUMES them.
